articles.title: Berlin is being blackmailed by hackers, mayor says
articles.summary: Kai Wegner says the German capital and city-state would not cave in to a ransom demand for data stolen in a cyber-attack.

articles.title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
articles.summary: This latest U.S. appeals court ruling sets up a rift between federal courts on event contracts, suggesting the U.S. Supreme Court may need to settle the matter.

articles.title: Spain asks EU's Frontex for help in processing Ceuta migrants
articles.summary: Of the over 70,000 migrants who illegally crossed into Ceuta from Morocco in late July, some 5,000 still remain in the Spanish exclave. Ceuta residents have been angrily protesting their continued presence.
